name: wpg-launcher
description: Steam-style launcher for Patreon/SubscribeStar games — Tauri desktop app, Cloudflare backend and publish tooling. Studio settings: launcher.config.json

scripts.demo:v1: node tools/publish.mjs midnight-manor 0.1.0 sample-game/v0.1.0 --exe MidnightManor.bat --cdn sample-game/cdn --notes "First playable build. Explore the ground floor of the manor."
scripts.demo:v2: node tools/publish.mjs midnight-manor 0.1.1 sample-game/v0.1.1 --exe MidnightManor.bat --cdn sample-game/cdn --notes "Added a new scene in the hallway. Removed an unused background."
scripts.worker:dev: node tools/configure.mjs && npm --prefix worker run dev
scripts.worker:deploy: node tools/configure.mjs && npm --prefix worker run deploy
